summary: Two things went right and one thing got materially worse. The first invoice was finally collected in full ($3,617.59 confirmed Aug 9) after three failed Zelle configurations across six days, ending with Barbara paying Derrek's personal phone number. Michelle sent her first proactive weekly leak-removal report (Aug 10) and Mica resumed weekly reel inspo (Aug 13). But the IG situation escalated from 'paused during the phone-farm rebuild' to active, repeating account loss: 'i'm having account issues every other day, i'm losing recovering losing recovering' (Aug 11). For the first time since onboarding Barbara voiced real worry ('i'm just getting worried about that') and asked for root cause; Derrek's answer was 'Dont worry about why, we got it and will have it fixed'. The backup IG @ name promised 'next week' on Aug 1 is now three weeks undelivered. Her Aug 11 TikTok link-in-bio question and her Aug 13 OFTV Dropbox drop both ended the week unanswered. She remains cooperative and is still shipping content, but the goodwill buffer is thinning and the next invoice lands Aug 15 on payment rails that have never worked cleanly.
